ov: Eight-legged arachnids with fangs that inject venom and spinnerets that make silk. With more than 53,000 species, they’re found in nearly every land habitat on every continent except Antarctica.

why.dg: Most bites are no worse than a bee sting, but a few spiders are dangerous, such as widow spiders, recluses and the Australian funnel-webs.
why.et: Cooked tarantulas are a delicacy in Cambodia.

rg: Every continent except Antarctica, in nearly every land habitat.
df: Predators, mostly of insects, which they liquefy with digestive enzymes. One species, Bagheera kiplingi, is mostly vegetarian.
fx: Most spiders live two years at most, but tarantulas can live over 20.
